svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 09/12 Purple Sidewalks (Common)
svg.desc: Late spring the jacarandas turn purple, and then the sidewalks under them turn purple too. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
